concepts.quote: Dividing by zero gives an error.
concepts.why: The blanket rule that any division by zero errors contradicts Java, where 1.0 / 0 in this very code yields Infinity rather than an error; the answer does not restrict the rule to int.
The answer says nothing about truncating / on int operands (7 / 2 vs 7.0 / 2).
The answer does not mention the int type, its range, or its arithmetic.
